svg.title: The product of the original budgets, each at most Cpaths, bounds the half-width sum by 2e−σR/(2d)C2 paths. At R = till(x) this has every prescribed negative rate. Under 8ε < σ, the remain- ing width σ/2 −2ε is positive and supplies the geometric reserve and polynomial mark. Footprint payments multiply scalar envelopes and old budgets by fixed constants and a four-dimensional extent factor. If these have rates u, v and extent rate zero, the payment has rate u + v; any strictly larger exponent absorbs the fixed and subpower factors. This recovers the inherited six-family atom and tail rate deductions with the stated geometric conversion dependency. The lifted record retains extra charges, true lengths, masks, orientations and width reserves. Readout recovers each tariffidentity and omitted-pair condition, so support conversion does not discard winding, multiplicity or polynomial marks.
